title: Death Executor
next_chapter_hook: After the executor left, the three-day deadline hung like a sword over his head. Chen Ji clutched the fragmented Tianji Record, feeling the weight of fate for the first time—how much time did he have left?

text.content:
Night fell like ink, and诡异的雾气弥漫在天青宗后山禁地入口处。陈机盘膝坐在一块青石上，眉心处的天机录印记隐隐作痛——这是近半月来第三次异动了。每一次异动都比上一次更剧烈，仿佛有什么东西正在苏醒，正在催促他揭开某个被刻意隐藏的真相。

他slowly睁开双眼，瞳孔深处倒映着远处的灯火，那些灯火来自天青宗议事大殿的方向。凌渊今夜在那里宴请玄武宗的使者，表面是共商抗魔大计，实则各怀鬼胎。而他，一个杂役弟子，本不该出现在这里。

dialogue.content: (Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed in his mind, carrying unprecedented gravity) Lad, you feel it, don't you? The Tianji Record is resonating, stronger than last time. I'll give you some advice—some truths... knowing them may not be a good thing.

text.content:
A self-deprecating smile curved Chen Ji's lips. A good thing? Ever since obtaining this fragmented Tianji Record, which day hasn't he been dancing on the blade's edge? Every time he used his foresight ability, his Heavenly Fate Value decreased by five points, and his Heavenly Fate Value... was already less than a hundred points.

He took a deep breath, pressed his right hand against his brow center, and the Tianji Record mark suddenly glowed brilliantly. A tearing pain struck, and his consciousness was forcibly dragged into a chaotic void.

Deep within the void, a blurry image gradually took shape. It was a burning palace, and in the center stood a high platform. On the platform stood a figure he knew intimately—it was himself. Covered in blood, a pitch-black sword thrust through his chest, his life force visibly draining away.

Before the "him," a black-robed figure was slowly拔出 the sword. The robe obscured the face, but that build, that posture... Chen Ji's eyes widened abruptly.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji's voice echoed in the void, trembling with disbelief) It's you... how can it be you!

text.content:
The black-robed figure seemed to hear his voice and slowly raised his head. From beneath the robe revealed half a face, the gruesome scar running diagonally from temple to jaw startlingly vivid in the firelight. It was a face Chen Ji would never forget—three years ago in Youming Valley, if this person hadn't rescued him, he would have died in that ambush.

The executor... was actually him?

dialogue.content: (In the void, the black-robed figure spoke, voice hoarse like dead wood scraping) Chen Ji, you saw it again. This time... it's the complete prophecy of Chapter Seven Hundred. I told you, those who peer into Heavenly Secrets will be counterattacked by Heavenly Secrets. You were too impatient.

text.content:
Chen Ji violently broke free from the illusion, his forehead covered in cold sweat. He discovered he was still sitting on the blue stone, but the surrounding fog had thickened to the point where he couldn't see his hand. And just three zhang away, a black-robed figure had appeared at some point, watching him silently.

Ling Yuan. This name was like a basin of ice water poured over him.

No—that's wrong. Ling Yuan should be entertaining guests in the great hall right now, how could he be here? Unless...

(The black-robed figure slowly removed his hood, revealing an aged yet familiar face—exactly how Ling Yuan looked) What, very surprised? I told you, every falling leaf of Tianqing Sect is within my perception. You thought you hid well, but you didn't know—from the moment you stepped onto the Back Mountain, I already knew.

Three years, Chen Ji. You made me wait so long.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji suppressed the surging emotions, his face showing his usual timid expression, voice slightly trembling) O-Old Sect Master... this disciple just couldn't sleep, came out for some fresh air, didn't mean to disturb you...

text.content: Ling Yuan let out a cold laugh, that laughter sounding especially harsh in the silent night. He walked closer step by step, each step carrying the pressure of crushing mountains.

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan pressed closer step by step, the death countdown has started, Chen Ji must make a choice—

choices.description: Tear off the disguise, use the Tianji Record's power to try foresee Ling Yuan's weakness, strike first
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan's cultivation is unfathomable, frontal confrontation is extremely risky

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils suddenly contracted, the mark at his brow center glowing again. A thin thread of Heavenly Secrets force probed out, trying to peek at Ling Yuan's movements within three hours—however, the images were blurry like reflections in water. The only clear image was something hidden in Ling Yuan's sleeve, emanating a cold, eerie glow. That light's fluctuation frequency, he had seen in some ancient text—it was an artifact that sealed souls!

choices.description: Present the waste persona, test Ling Yuan's true purpose and bottom line
choices.risk_hint: May be seen through by Ling Yuan

text.content: Chen Ji thudded to his knees, his whole body trembling like a sieve. He knew Ling Yuan detested weaklings the most—the more cowardly, the more it would stimulate the other's desire for control. Ling Yuan indeed stopped his steps, looking down at him from above, a satisfied glint flickering in his eyes. "Trash is still trash." He coldly snorted, "Since you're so sensible, I'll tell you—come to the depths of the Forbidden Grounds in three days to get your things.届时，老夫会亲自送你上路。"

choices.description: Surface compliance, secretly leave a backup plan, wait for the opportunity to counterattack
choices.visible_cost: Must pay the price of dignity
choices.visible_reward: Win three days of buffer time
choices.risk_hint: May be controlled by Ling Yuan, unable to execute follow-up plans

text.content: Chen Ji gritted his teeth, his five fingers deeply embedded in the dirt. He slowly raised his head, eyes full of fear and pleading. "O-Old Sect Master, spare my life... this disciple is willing to do anything..." Ling Yuan narrowed his eyes, as if examining an interesting toy. After a moment, he suddenly burst into laughter, the sound full of mockery. "Indeed atrash。不过..." He crouched down, took a pitch-black token from his sleeve and tossed it before Chen Ji, "Three days from now at the hour of midnight, I'll wait for you here.届时，替我做一件事。"

Chen Ji picked up the token, his fingertips touching the cold metal surface, and a familiar aura flooded into his Mental Sea. His pupils suddenly contracted—this was a Holy Sect communication token! Ling Yuan actually had connections with the Holy Sect? No, wait—upon closer inspection, the aura contained within the token was completely different from Holy Sect techniques, instead carrying some... remnant fluctuation of ancient forbidden arts.

He suddenly recalled what Mo Xiansheng once said: every successor of the Tianji Record has an "executor" responsible for ending their life at a specific moment, to ensure Heavenly Secrets aren't abused. Could Ling Yuan be...

dialogue.content: (Ling Yuan seemed to see through his thoughts, his voice low as an abyss) Are you wondering if I'm the Tianji Record's executor? Hmph, not entirely. My task is merely to collect your life at a specific time. But before you die, there's one final step—find the complete Tianji Record and give it to me. This is the rule your good master left behind. Don't blame me.

text.content:
Chen Ji stared fixedly at Ling Yuan's face, trying to find flaws in that wrinkled visage. His mind raced, connecting all known information. Ling Yuan was the previous generation's candidate for Tianji Record succession, harboring resentment after being skipped by the Tianji Record. But Mo Xiansheng said the Tianji Record's choices never err—could Ling Yuan's resentment itself be part of some grand scheme?

Suddenly, he noticed Ling Yuan's right hand trembling slightly when speaking—that position... was exactly where the sleeve-concealed item was in the Tianji Record's foresight!

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji slowly stood up, brushed the dust off his knees, his voice regaining composure) Sect Master, you said just now this is the rule my master left behind. Then this junior dares to ask—is the item in your sleeve related to the Tianji Record's inheritance? That fluctuation... I seem to have felt it somewhere before.

text.content: Ling Yuan's expression changed slightly, then returned to normal. But that momentary change didn't escape Chen Ji's eyes. He had gambled correctly—the item in Ling Yuan's sleeve was definitely the key. Chen Ji began reassessing this "archenemy" before him: he wasn't simply a perpetrator, but more like a piece in a larger chess game.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji decided to further apply pressure, testing Ling Yuan's bottom line—

choices.description: Directly point out the past where Ling Yuan was abandoned by the Tianji Record, provoke him to reveal more flaws
choices.risk_hint: May cause Ling Yuan to act prematurely

dialogue.content:
(A meaningful smile curved Chen Ji's lips) Sect Master, this junior heard that a hundred years ago, the Tianji Record once had another choice... unfortunately that person was skipped by the Tianji Record. This junior is very curious—what does it feel like to be abandoned by your own obsession?

Ling Yuan's eyes erupted with fierce killing intent, his aura around his body surged violently. He abruptly raised his hand, five fingers like hooks grasping toward Chen Ji. However, in that instant, his right sleeve slipped down, revealing a pitch-black token—the token bore an engraving Chen Ji knew extremely well: the Tianji Record's mark!

choices.description: Pretend to be terrified, actually secretly记下 all details, analyze the layout after returning
choices.risk_hint: May cause Ling Yuan to underestimat eyou, but it's also an opportunity

text.content: Chen Ji's body softened, falling to his knees again, kowtowing repeatedly. Ling Yuan's killing intent suddenly收敛, he looked down at the "trash" beneath his feet, coldly snorted. "Smart of you. Three days from now, the hour of midnight, be there or be square." With that, his figure turned into black smoke, disappearing into the thick fog. Chen Ji slowly raised his head, a flash of sharpness flickering in his eyes—the token in Ling Yuan's sleeve, he saw it clearly. That was the Tianji Record's inheritance token, yet held by Ling Yuan. There must be something fishy here.

choices.description: Surface agree to cooperate, actually use the Tianji Record to set up a layout in advance, make Ling Yuan his chess piece
choices.visible_reward: Obtain initiative over Ling Yuan's actions
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate consumption too great, may affect subsequent abilities

text.content: Chen Ji raised his head, eyes full of "pleading." "Sect Master rest assured, this junior will definitely keep the appointment in three days." Ling Yuan nodded in satisfaction, turned and left. After that figure completely vanished, Chen Ji slowly stood up, the Tianji Record mark at his brow center glowing again. He used a foresight ability—the midnight hour three days later, he saw the secret behind Ling Yuan: the soul sealed within that token was actually a wisp of remnant soul! That soul's aura was identical to Mo Xiansheng's!

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul? Chen Ji's back grew cold. He suddenly understood—perhaps that token Ling Yuan held was Mo Xiansheng's other half! The guardian of the Tianji Record wasn't just one remnant soul, but divided into two parts—one part was guiding him, while the other was imprisoned by Ling Yuan!

This was the true reason Ling Yuan could become the "executor." He held Mo Xiansheng's other half's life in his hands!

dialogue.content: (Mo Xiansheng's voice in his mind, trembling for the first time) Lad... what did you see? Why do I... why do I feel a familiar aura? That is... that can't be...

(Chen Ji didn't answer Mo Xiansheng's question, he tightly gripped that pitch-black token, his knuckles white from force) Old Mo, I'll ask you something. Mo Xiansheng—the real Mo Xiansheng—does he have another half?

text.content: Silence stretched for a long time in his mind. When Mo Xiansheng spoke again, his voice carried bitterness and relief.

dialogue.content: (Mo Xiansheng's voice finally sounded, carrying a hundred years of accumulated weariness) Yes. I... no, she and I were originally one body with two souls. She was responsible for guarding the truth of the Tianji Record, while I guided the successor. A hundred years ago, she was imprisoned by that madman Ling Yuan, her consciousness sealed with forbidden arts. I always thought she had dissipated, didn't expect... she's still there. When you meet Ling Yuan in three days, you must rescue her. That is... my only obsession.

text.content:
Chen Ji fell silent. He looked at the token Ling Yuan left behind, then recalled the black-robed figure stabbing toward his heart in the foresight. Three days. Only three days. Ling Yuan wanted him to go to the Forbidden Grounds, ostensibly to deliver the Tianji Record, but in reality it was a certain-death situation. And his only chance lay with that imprisoned "other half of Mo Xiansheng."

If he could find a way to rescue her within three days, perhaps he could break this deadly game. But Ling Yuan's cultivation was heaven-reaching, and he held a hostage—how could he break the situation?

Chen Ji slowly turned, looking toward Tianqing Sect. His gaze pierced through the night, as if seeing a certain figure苦修 at a desk—Su Qingyao, that woman who had come infinitely close to the truth three times yet had been cleverly deflected by him. Perhaps... it was time to let her know some of the truth.

choice.prompt: The three-day deadline is imminent, Chen Ji must make a crucial choice—

choices.description: Reveal part of the truth to the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, use her strength to counter Ling Yuan
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao may demand more truth

dialogue.content: That night, Chen Ji secretly infiltrated the Inner Disciple residences. When Su Qingyao saw him, a flash of surprise flickered in her eyes, then returned to calm. "I knew this day would come." She said indifferently, "Go ahead, who exactly are you?" Chen Ji took a deep breath, showing his true face for the first time: "I'm the successor of the Tianji Record. Ling Yuan is going to kill me in three days. I need your help." Su Qingyao's eyes widened abruptly, then erupted with炽热的光芒—那是猎人发现猎物时的excited，而非fearful。

choices.description: Use the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path's special channels to contact Ye Qing, borrow the Demonic Path's power to搅乱 the situation
choices.visible_cost: Owe the Demonic Path a favor
choices.visible_reward: Obtain strategic-level ally's demonic fog cover
choices.risk_hint: Demonic Path involvement may trigger greater complications

dialogue.content: Chen Ji took out a blood-red jade pendant, Ye Qing's emergency contact item left for him. He poured spiritual energy into it, and after a moment, demonic energy coalesced into a blurry figure. "Chen Ji? It's late, what do you want?" Ye Qing's voice carried a hint of laziness. Chen Ji didn't waste words, directly简要 explained the matter of Ling Yuan and the Tianji Record. "Interesting." Ye Qing轻笑, "That old fox Ling Yuan, I've long wanted to deal with him. Three days from now, I'll bring people near the Forbidden Grounds. Then, you can do whatever you want."

choices.description: Don't rely on anyone's strength, use the Tianji Record to foresee every detail, carve a bloody path through the desperate situation
choices.risk_hint: Once failed, will be beyond redemption

text.content: Chen Ji put away the jade pendant, slowly closed his eyes. He began frantically consuming Heavenly Fate Value, peering into future possibilities again and again. Every image was a line of life and death, every detail was an opportunity to survive. When the eastern sky began to brighten, he had consumed fifteen points of Heavenly Fate, yet wove an extremely intricate net. At the midnight hour three days later, Ling Yuan would encounter a variable he never anticipated—and that variable was Chen Ji himself. He would make Ling Yuan understand that the man chosen by the Tianji Record would never be prey!

Dawn broke, and the fog on Tianqing Sect Back Mountain gradually dissipated. Chen Ji stood at the entrance of the Forbidden Grounds, his gaze profound as an abyss. He tucked Ling Yuan's token into his chest, turned and walked toward the sect.

Ling Yuan thought holding Mo Xiansheng's other half's soul gave him complete control, but he didn't know the true hunter often appears as prey. At midnight three days later, this grudge spanning a hundred years will finally meet its end. And Chen Ji will be the one laughing at the finish!

dialogue.content: (Mo Xiansheng's voice in his mind, carrying a trace of comfort) Lad, no matter which path you choose, I'll be with you. She... has waited for this day far too long.

text.content:
Chen Ji didn't answer, only gave a slight nod. He raised his head, looking toward where Tianqing Sect's Council Hall stood in the distance. Ling Yuan's figure seemed to still be there, drinking and laughing with Xuanwu Sect's envoys. What a deeply scheming old fox, able to chat merrily before killing.

A cold smile curved his lips as he turned, vanishing into the morning mist.

Death Executor? Hmph, since the Tianji Record chose me, then let the Tianji Record execute you instead. Three days from now, who will be the victor, remains to be seen.
